claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as a visual novel featuring point-and-click investigation elements combined with small mini-games.

citations.review_text:
Slow. Boring. Not for me.

The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog is basically a visual novel with some point-and-click investigation and small Sonic-style mini-games. The concept sounds interesting, but the actual experience felt far too slow for me.

Most of the game is reading dialogue, clicking through conversations, and slowly moving through the investigation. The story and Sonic characters are fine, and the hand-drawn art looks good, but the pacing made it difficult for me to stay interested.

I kept waiting for the game to pick up, but it continued at the same slow pace. Even the investigation sections felt quite limited, so there wasn't enough actual gameplay to keep me engaged.

It's free, so there's not much to lose by trying it, especially if you're a big Sonic fan or enjoy visual novels.

Personally, though, I found it very boring and too slow. Not recommended from my side.

The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog is a delightful surprise that successfully blends humor, mystery, and the beloved Sonic cast. The story is entertaining and full of clever twists, while the dialogue is well written and often genuinely funny.

The charming visual style, combined with visual novel storytelling, investigation mechanics, and fun minigames, keeps the experience engaging from start to finish. Although it's relatively short, the game delivers a memorable story and plenty of fan service for Sonic fans.

The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog is a great example of how a free game can offer a polished and enjoyable adventure that's well worth playing.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game has no fail state and allows players to brute-force or easily work out the deduction puzzles.

citations.review_text: This game was alright, it wasn't amazing. It felt easy to work out all the puzles in this game. BUT AFTER I LEFT THE GAME ON THE FINAL PART MY SAVE DATA WAS GONE. Do download ths game as it's free, the art  is beautifulb and it looks nice in your steam library

Never played a Sonic game and my knowledge of the franchise is equally null. But this doesn't ask for any prior experience, directly jump in with a cute cast of characters and solve a murder mystery! Not too challenging deduction puzzles (no fail state, you can stumble onto the correct outcome by brute-forcing), lovely story and music, and the minigame was quite fun. A great package and very surprising coming from one of the bigger names in gaming, especially considering no charge. Well worth a try and the time spent. More like this please!

claims.claim: Reviewers mention that the game includes accessibility options to assist players during difficult sections.

citations.review_text: It was fine. The logic for finding the "murderer" didn't really make sense but it was fun exploring the train. The platforming game was pretty fun and it gets a bit tough near the end. It took me about 7-8 tries for that final sprint. There is an assist mode, in case it's needed as well.

The art style and aesthetic of the game are great. The dialogue is cute and funny. Little series and SEGA references are strewn throughout. There are accessibility options and the game difficulty is fairly breezy without being boring.

claims.claim: Reviewers highlight that the game is available to play for free

citations.review_text: really good game i wasent gonna play it at first but i tried it and it was a really good game and this was free
This is a pretty good visual novel. Compelling story, great interpretation and use of Sonic's friends and great presentation, definitely recommend and it's free

A fun adventure story with Sonic and friends playing a whodunnit murder mystery game in celebration of Amy's birthday.

The game is mostly a visual novel, with some point & click hidden object elements, but also an "endless runner" style minigame is integrated into the experience too, which was a pleasant surprise to see.

If you'd rather just stick to the story and not worry about the minigame, there are settings you can adjust in the Options menu to make the experience easier, which was very considerate of the development team to include for everyone's enjoyment.

Short and sweet, it's definitely worth your time, and it's free to play. Even if you are not very familiar with the Sonic The Hedgehog franchise, this game gives you a glimpse of some of its beloved characters, and is enjoyable enough on its own merits.

citations.review_text:
A short detective game that's incredibly good for how unique the premise is. 

Despite being a VN it does require some decent technical skill and I had to retry all the mandatory side scroller minigames multiple times to beat it. The screen scrolls incredibly fast during these games and there's a lot going on. Also, it is at a sort of isometric angle so it's hard to see where your character is positioned sometimes, which is incredibly important because you can clip obstacles or collect the rings (a certain quantity are mandatory for progressing each level) in multiple lanes at once. Speaking of this mechanic, the quantity of rings required to pass a level is surprisingly high and even people who are very good at this type of game will need to retry even if they passed the obstacles. 

If you are not good at this genre of video games I recommend turning the speed down in the options menu at the beginning of the game down to 80 or 90%. 

Otherwise, a fun use of 2-3 hours.

The art is cute and its cool that it is free. However the final minigame pissed me off so badly that I walked away from my computer and came back to it later (hence the 6 hour playtime). An otherwise fun game.

This game was very well put together and the visuals were beautiful! The plot was fun and I enjoyed all the fun little interactions between characters. I wasn't expecting the run and jump game element but I thought it was really cool though it was tough to get through especially at the end. Over all it was such a fun game great for sonic fan! I genuinely can't believe I got to play such a high quality game for free!

citations.review_text:
As a game it's split in two very distinct experiences:
The main part is a fun, light-hearted short murder mystery with silly characters and sillier situations in which you can't get stuck
And then there's the "THINK!" part, in which you play a progressively harder, mandatory ring-collecting minigame in what is the most nauseating case of guitar hero eyes I ever experienced, which very much spoils the whole experience, and is only marginally saved by the accessibility features that allow players to have an easier time collecting (and not losing!) rings

The game started off rather simplistic but slowly increased in difficulty as the game went on. I liked that it wasn't just a story game and had actual sonic-like minigames throughout. The characters were drawn in a cute artstyle while still maintaining their likeness which I enjoyed a lot. The story itself was a bit difficult to follow at times (at least for me) but I still enjoyed it nonetheless. Overall I recommend this game. It took me around 3 hours to beat but that is because I procrastinated and suck at sonic, lol.

This game has been in my library for a while now, and I finally got around to trying it out. I honestly found this super fun and cute. The "THINK" minigames got progressively harder, but that made it more fun in my opinion, as it requires quick thinking and a bit of skill
